name: S4U: Dushi Pengke 2011 Yu ai De Zhong Quan
source:
S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH is a text-driven adventure game powered by immersive keyboard interactions. The story is set in Castor Yard, a fictional modern city in 2011. You play as Miki, who works part-time chatting on behalf of clients, meeting a variety of people and Cyber-Life online. Create your own memories in Caster Yard through countless small and big decisions made with each keystroke.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2612700/S4U_CITYPUNK_2011_AND_LOVE_PUNCH/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH是一款由沉浸式键盘交互驱动的文本驱动冒险游戏。故事发生在2011年的虚构现代城市Castor Yard。你扮演Miki，她兼职代表客户聊天，结识各种各样的人和在线网络生活。通过每次击键做出的无数大大小小的决定，在Caster Yard中创造你自己的回忆。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2612700/S4U_CITYPUNK_2011_AND_LOVE_PUNCH/]Steam[/url]]
